cards.title: Repeating text with *
cards.body: Multiplying a string by a whole number repeats it.

cards.title: Lines that grow
cards.body: Combine the loop variable with string repetition and each line can be a bit longer than the last.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: Type 5 and it crashes with a `TypeError`. The error points at line 2: tap the line that really causes it.

bug.fix: `input()` gives text, and text can only be repeated a whole number of times. Line 1 needs `int(input())`.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: i is 0 and then 1, so the lines have 1 and then 2 stars.
